channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Sterling Brown | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Sterling Brown from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on George Hill, Sterling Brown
item.description:
Bucks@Giannis Antetokounmpo says,

“Life tells you to do something and you do. I saw George and Sterling, and George decided not to play the game. George didn’t put any pressure on me. Sterling wasn’t going to play... As a leader and a teammate wasn’t going to leave them behind.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on George Hill, Sterling Brown, Aug 29, 2020. Source: Twitter @MarcJSpears.

item.title: RJ Barrett on Sterling Brown
item.description:
Reached Saturday, Barrett said he was not briefed on the response before it was filed and was surprised by its tone.

“It is my hope that this can be resolved in a constructive way for Mr. Brown and for the community. I think it’s counterproductive for anybody to turn up the heat with rhetoric like this,”

RJ Barrett on Sterling Brown, Aug 26, 2018. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Adam Silver on Sterling Brown
item.description:
Kristian Winfield:Adam Silver on Sterling Brown:

“I saw the video for the first time when the public saw it. It's horrific. It was difficult to watch. It's painful. ... It's a reality in our country right now that there's a disconnect between young people of color and police officers.”

Adam Silver on Sterling Brown, May 31, 2018. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.
